note: What a server sends to put a champion back on the field. The header names the unit this is about.

fields.name: atX
fields.note: Where it returns, along one ground axis, in world units. A client sets the champion on the nearest open ground to this point and atZ.

fields.name: atY
fields.note: Where it returns, in height, in world units. A client takes the height from the ground; any other use is not recorded.

fields.name: atZ
fields.note: Where it returns, along the other ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: atX
fields.note: Where it returns, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: atZ
fields.note: Where it returns, along the other, in world units.

fields.name: resource
